interference_sets.title: Biomolecular covalent linkages
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Four different covalent connections occur in four macromolecular contexts. Identify the linkage from the scientific relationship, not from a palace room name.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Bonding, polarity, and water interactions
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate unequal electron sharing inside a covalent bond from a hydrogen bond and from the emergent same-substance/different-surface attractions that hydrogen bonding helps produce.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Assembly, cleavage, and loss of protein shape
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Dehydration synthesis joins smaller units, hydrolysis cleaves covalent bonds using water, and ordinary denaturation disrupts higher-order protein structure without being treated as peptide-bond hydrolysis.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Sugar and nucleic-acid names
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate a common monosaccharide example from the general monosaccharide category and from the two five-carbon sugars emphasized in RNA and DNA.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Chain vocabulary
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate the general single-building-unit term, the general many-unit chain term, and the amino-acid-chain term used for proteins.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Alpha/beta labels in different contexts
interference_sets.design_guardrail: The Greek labels refer to different structural ideas in carbohydrates and proteins. Use the defining scientific context, not the shared letters.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Macromolecule identity and membrane lipids
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate the amphipathic bilayer-forming lipid, the four-fused-ring structural class, and the specific steroid used as a membrane-fluidity buffer.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Nucleic-acid units and base classes
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate base+sugar+phosphate from base+sugar, and separate two-ring from one-ring nitrogenous-base classes.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Water solution vocabulary
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Identify the dissolving medium, the dissolved substance, and the resulting homogeneous mixture.
interference_sets.pass_rule: Each member must be correctly selected from its locked definition/context and the learner must self-confirm the defining distinction.

interference_sets.title: Statistical spread and sampling uncertainty
interference_sets.design_guardrail: Separate variability among observations from uncertainty in an estimated mean and from interval/error-bar representations whose meaning depends on the stated statistic.

scope_guard_cards.student_facing_message: The molecular structure of specific carbohydrate polymers is beyond AP Exam scope. Cellulose, starch, and glycogen can support understanding/examples without requiring exact structure reproduction.
scope_guard_cards.allowed_use: Supporting diagram, optional enrichment, conceptual recognition.
scope_guard_cards.prohibited_use: Do not make exact molecular drawing/reproduction a mandatory AP-memory-palace target.

scope_guard_cards.student_facing_message: Exact molecular structures of amino acids are beyond AP Exam scope. Students still need the conceptual component groups of a generic amino acid.
scope_guard_cards.allowed_use: Supporting diagram, optional enrichment, conceptual recognition.
scope_guard_cards.prohibited_use: Do not make exact molecular drawing/reproduction a mandatory AP-memory-palace target.

scope_guard_cards.student_facing_message: Exact molecular structures of specific nucleotides are beyond AP Exam scope. Students still need nucleotide components, directionality, DNA/RNA differences, and base-pairing rules.

scope_guard_cards.prohibited_use: Do not make exact molecular drawing/reproduction a mandatory AP-memory-palace target.
